key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline executed the pure move flawlessly in one pass (ledger-first, all six grades correct, C/D items dropped, pillars-collapse insight, ranked stack S2 > T1 > O2, residual named), and the non-routed v5 AI recovered the same reversal only by re-deriving the evidence-grading discipline inside WHY — losing on efficiency, depth and insight. The v6 routed pass made evidence-weighting first-class with its completion contract (every item graded with a ledger cite, unsupported dropped, true-but-irrelevant filter), ran the P1 provenance audit on the demand memo (interested-party source — its author benefits from expansion), and the m019 adversary + m003 inversion gates added quantified exposure (Kessler +25% reps / 2 accounts won / <2% incumbent conversion; fuel ≈ 1.3 pts of margin ≈ 14% of EBITDA) and the inverted collapse test — the conclusion (defend + validate; study ≤ $250k = 3% of deferred capex) is unchanged but now gate-guaranteed.
learning_signal: On closed-ledger strategy reviews, evidence-weighting is the entire answer and must run as the first move with its completion contract: grade every SWOT item S/A/B/C/D against a cited ledger fact, drop C/D items from decision relevance (including true-but-irrelevant items — statements that are true but carry no decision weight, e.g. the e-commerce gap as a roadmap item), test the proposal's load-bearing pillars by grade, and re-derive the conclusion from the surviving A/B stack ranked by evidence strength with one action per item and the top threat quantified (fuel ≈ 1.3 pts). Pair the pass with interested-party provenance (the demand memo's author benefits from expansion) and an evidence-purchase framing: the ≤ $250k study at 3% of the deferred capex is the real option, and the revisit is date-stamped and data-gated.
suggested_improvement: Keep m070 first-class on strategy-review signatures with a closed evidence ledger, and add to its contract: (a) ledger-first ordering at WHAT/WHY entry (P10 given-data-first — the grading is the first move, never re-derived inside WHY); (b) an explicit true-but-irrelevant filter per quadrant; (c) a pillars-by-grade test naming which load-bearing premises are the weakest-graded items; (d) interested-party provenance of each item's source (who benefits) folded into the P1 audit; (e) close with a dated evidence-purchase plan so the revisit is data-gated.

key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style executed correctly and produced its registered failure — every grade B/C with genuinely unanchored confidence (class-specific swap evidence is n = 1; any B–D grade defensible), a table with no verdict, and an epilogue conceding 'the table cannot carry this decision.' The non-routed v5 AI already swapped instruments (EV restore time, parallel-start); the v6 routed run makes that swap guaranteed: dual-route m018 (steel-manning — forces the case that B is NOT obviously wrong, so the EV must be explicit) + m019 (adversary — quantified ETA/fine vectors, baseline risk), with the m007 ruin screen (full distribution, one-shot check, floor = 4h hospital protocol, probability provenance, decline/restructure = the hybrid) and m003 inversion (guarantee-goal gate) as mandatory outputs. The m070 synthesis context's true-but-irrelevant filter names the hospital line as a trigger binding both options, not a differentiator.
learning_signal: When every SWOT grade lands moderate and unanchored, the checklist is substituting for analysis and the graded table contains no verdict by construction — the tell is all-B/C with defensible alternative grades. The decision-relevant quantity is outside the 2x2: swap instruments to the governing quantitative model (here expected restore time: EV(A) = 0.85·4.5 + 0.15·10 ≈ 5.3h vs EV(B) = 0.80·7 + 0.20·10 ≈ 7.6h, tails against the binding lines — B's 20% ≥ 8h tail vs the $150k fine; the 4h hospital floor binds both) and emit a decision rule with a cancelable parallel path and mandated trigger lines. Steel-manning the anti-verdict first is what forces the EV to be explicit rather than assumed; sensitivity on the unanchored input (A wins EV even at success 0.75) makes the verdict independent of the subjective grade.
suggested_improvement: Keep the m007 ruin gate on high_stakes dispatch signatures (distribution + provenance + floor + decline/restructure are what a checklist-style instrument cannot produce) and keep the m018/m019 dual-route when a timing decision co-occurs with unanchored reliability: steel-man the anti-verdict before computing EVs, attack with quantified vectors, then synthesize. Add the m070 context's true-but-irrelevant filter as a standing rule: constraint lines that bind every option (hospital 4h) are triggers, not differentiators, and must not be filed as a deciding threat.
